QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Preventative Measures
QuestInfo.0: Find Eremose to get the location for the next phase of your training.
QuestInfo.1: Mushroom Castle has recently been invaded by Vikings and needs your help defending itself. Eremos instructs you to defeat 1,200 Vikings before they take the castle and cause even bigger problems.
QuestInfo.2: The fight with the Vikings in Mushroom Castle has strengthened your body and your resolve!
